title: The Community That Defied the Day of Rest
intro: Step into a coastal settlement where a divine command set aside one day for worship and restraint. A group within this community chose to test the limits of that command with a cunning plan, leading to a transformation that would echo through the ages. Who were these souls, and what became of them?
clues: We lived near the coast, where the sea provided our livelihood.
We were commanded to honor one day of the week, setting it aside from worldly pursuits.
On that day, the fish came to us in great numbers, as if tempting us to break the command.
We devised a plan to trap the fish on the eve of the sacred day, then collect them after it passed.
When some among us warned against this deceit, we ignored their counsel and persisted.
For our transgression, we were transformed into apes, despised and rejected.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Denying a prophet sent to them

location.label: Key Element
options: The fire that was made cool
The staff that became a serpent

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Struck by a shower of stones

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
